description: Tasks Viewer – Kanban Chart is a custom Power BI visual developed by Softcial, designed to help users visualize and manage tasks using a classic kanban-style layout. With an intuitive interface and flexible display options, this visual is perfect for tracking workflows, project statuses, or any process that benefits from a column-based organization of tasks. This visual is ideal for business users who need a high-level yet interactive view of task distribution across categories or statuses — known as buckets. Whether managing project timelines, overseeing support tickets, or handling recruitment pipelines, this visual makes it easy to gain insights and take action. Key Features Display up to 3 buckets – Categorize your tasks by up to three columns (buckets) for clear segmentation. Display up to 10 tasks per bucket – Visualize up to 10 tasks in each bucket with automatic vertical scrolling. Adjustable task display count – Choose how many tasks to show at once to prioritize visibility and screen real estate. Customizable font size – Improve legibility and presentation by adjusting the font size according to your needs. Business Use Cases Project Management: Display tasks segmented by project phases such as To Do, In Progress, and Completed.
